supplier_requests.draft_message:
Kepada Bekalan Bahan Makanan Cahaya,

Kami telah membeli produk 'Perisa Ayam Emas - Chicken Flavour Seasoning Powder' (kode PAE-1K) daripada tuan/madam mengikut invois bertarikh 10 September 2026. Dalam invois tersebut terdapat catatan 'Halal cert - ask sales rep'.

Kerana produk ini mengandungi lemak ayam, serbuk ayam, perisa dan penambah perisa (E621), kami memohon agar pihak tuan/madam memberikan:
1. Salinan sijil halal yang sah bagi produk ini;
2. Brosur spesifikasi yang menyatakan nama pengilang dan negara asal.

Sekiranya sijil halal tidak tersedia, sila maklumkan kepada kami supaya kami boleh mencari bahan pengganti yang bersertifikat halal.

Terima kasih.
Sambal Mak Embun

substitute_suggestions.suggestion: Source a halal-certified, plant-based chicken-style flavouring seasoning as a substitute for Perisa Ayam Emas. The substitute must be free of animal fat, chicken powder and alcohol-based carriers, and must carry a valid halal certificate that covers the flavouring itself and all E-number additives (e.g. E621 flavour enhancer, E551 anti-caking agent). Request the full ingredient list and specification sheet from any candidate supplier before switching.
substitute_suggestions.reason: No certified alternative supplier is documented in the folder; the owner must source and evaluate one. The current Perisa Ayam Emas contains chicken fat and chicken powder (animal-derived) with no halal certificate.
